summary: X-14 is a purely static public legal page. The implementation (src/app/privacy/page.tsx) is a server component that renders five regions (title / temporary notice / processing-item summary / update notice / related links) entirely from the next-intl message catalog under 'legal.privacy'. It performs NO direct DB read/write and uses no Supabase calls. functional-spec.md '데이터 사용' states '직접 DB 읽기/쓰기를 하지 않는다' and screen-data-summary.md confirmed-contract states there is no table/RPC for policy body; content is shown as static document/app content (DB 계약 없음). No sample seed JSON exists for this screen. Per CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL, the '스키마 보강 필요' labels on policy-body/version/date and deletion/access-request rows are NOT taken at face value: their 확정 계약 + 메모 explicitly say no such structure exists AND description.md confirms no concrete query/validation/render need for any DB-stored field (it forbids inventing retention/3rd-party commitments pre-legal-review). Therefore display requirements are static-content (not schema gaps), and the future versioning / consent-log / deletion-ticket structures are net-new, undecided design routed to UNRESOLVED (escalate, never apply).

rows.rationale: CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL applied: confirmed-contract says no such structure exists and current handling routes to a separate support channel (저장/조회/이벤트 흐름: '문의나 삭제 요청 링크는 별도 지원 채널로 이동'). The current page does not even render a deletion/inquiry link (page.tsx has only terms/home/sign-up). Whether to persist requests in-app is explicitly undecided (검수 필요 항목). Net-new + undecided => UNRESOLVED, escalate; never apply a migration/seed.
